responses.text: You new to Freeside? Haven't seen you around.
You looking to join the Kings?
Do I know you? Whatever.
I hear you're working out pretty well. The King's taken a shine to you.
Stick by the Kings, and the Kings'll stick by you.
I've been hearing good things about you. Keep it up.
Hey pal, what's shaking?
You're okay in my book.
Hey there. You should stop by Freeside more often.
You got guts, showing your face around here.
You're lucky the King's a forgiving man.
I don't need to talk to you.
I wish you never came to Freeside.
Back again? What's next, burn down the Wrangler?
You're not wanted around here. Scram.
Some people seem to think you've helped the community, but I have my doubts.
There's talk of you being a menace, but I think you mean well.
Well, you definitely accomplished some things here, but I can't tell if Freeside is better for it or not.
You have got to be the craziest asshole I've ever met.
A couple of us started a pool trying to guess what you've going to do next.
Don't take this the wrong way, but are you, like, crazy or something?
Heard there was some excitement in one of the casinos in the Strip. Bunch of people got hurt when some nut started attacking people.
Things are tense on the Strip right now. The head of one of Mr. House's Families was killed. Time to lay low, you ask me.
Some nut attempted to kill the head of one of Mr. House's Families recently. Whoever did it is either crazy or has balls the size of Freeside.
Did you hear someone managed to fight their way through the Chairmen and flee the Strip after being caught? Wonder if they're hiding out in Freeside.
Looks like Gomorrah's under new management. I wonder what happened?
There's talk of someone going into the Lucky 38 to talk to Mr. House. That's bullshit. Everyone knows Mr. House doesn't talk to anyone.
Man, I thought those tin cans of Mr. House's were tough before. Have you seen the shit they can do now?
Turns out Mr. House wasn't so safe up in his tower after all!
I wonder how Mr. House died. I figure it wasn't old age.
How are we supposed to sleep with the Lucky 38 lit up 24/7?
Holy crap! You're the one they're saying killed the Legion honcho right?
Word on the street is that the leader of the Legion bought it. Too bad, someone was finally going to do something about all the NCR around here.
You hear how Mr. House said "uncle?" Vegas is gonna join the NCR. So much for Freeside.
Did you hear? Someone bombed the monorail down at McCarran, so everyone's been forced to come through here to get to the Strip. Business is booming.
Seems like they've got things straightened out in McCarran now, but we're still seeing a big increase in traffic here.
I can't believe someone stopped the NCR president from getting killed. If anyone deserves it, it's that jerk.
Someone took a shot at the NCR president, but the lucky bastard got away. Oh well, it was a good try.
Hey, did you hear the NCR president got whacked? Good for whoever did it, I say. Couldn't have happened to a nicer guy.
There's mutterings from the NCR people around here that some local hero of theirs died. Whatever.
Turns out some military hero the Squatters admired was actually a slimeball. An NCR soldier who's actually a dick? Who would've thought? {Heavy sarcasm at the end}
Heh, word is the leader of the Fiends got taken down. I would have done it myself, it he ever had the courage to step into Freeside. {Sheer bravado}
I heard that some of the bosses of the Fiends were killed. Wouldn't be surprised if the NCR had something to do with it.
You hear the Legion attacked Bitter Springs? If we're lucky, the NCR will pull some of their soldiers away from here and send them that way.
Word is the Khans signed a treaty with the NCR. Never saw that coming. {Emphasis on "that" as it truly was surprising.}
The Khans used to be a big deal around here, but look at them now. There's talk that they were all killed up in the mountains.
Weird, someone just told me that the Khans split the Vegas area. Wonder where they went, and why.
I can't believe the King is dead. What's going to happen to us now?
If you had asked me a month ago, I'd have said we'd never willingly work with the NCR. But look at us now.
I still can't believe the King agreed to work with the NCR. But he's the King, and the King knows best.
So far working with the NCR hasn't been too bad. If anything, things seem to be getting better.
Great, just when you think the NCR can't possibly sink their claws deeper, the town of Primm signs up to join the Republic.
Sounds like the NCR and the Legion are both gearing up for a fight. We've been seeing a lot more soldiers around.
The big showdown between the NCR and the Legion is coming soon, believe you me.
I heard some Squatters talking about some fancy pants Rangers coming into the area soon. Like we need more NCR here.
Word is those tough guys rangers are here. I ain't seen them myself, but how scary can they be?
Everyone's talking about Hoover Dam nowadays. I wish the battle would just happen already. The suspense is killing me.
Hey, isn't that the King's dog?
Heya Rex, how you doing boy?
I see you've hired a Follower doctor. Smart move, Freeside being what it is.
That friend of yours NCR? He looks like he's NCR.
Hellooo, cowgirl! You mind if talk to your lady friend a bit instead of you?
Huh. Nice robot. You with the Followers or something?
Whoa. That's a whole lotta mutant you got with you there. Still, long as it doesn't cause trouble it's all good.
Nice to see a human palling around with a ghoul. I see a lot of people around here avoid them.
Your girl's kinda cute, but not my type at all. I don't go for smart chicks.
Watch yourself. There's some unsavory types about.
The Squatters have been more and more trouble lately.
Man, I'm hungry. I'd give anything for a Fancy Lad. Wait, I mean- you know what I mean!
Squatters aren't happy about the water rationing, but then when are they ever happy?
It's gotten so bad that even I think twice before going out at night around here.
The bodyguards at the gates aren't so bad. Except that Orris guy. That bastard runs his mouth a little too much.
Can't wait to hit the Wrangler tonight. Just me and my favorite girl.
I've been saving up for one of those sweet pistols at the Silver Rush. That'll get me some respect.
Saw a guy try to rush through the south gate a few days ago. Nothin' left but dust, you know?
Those Squatters think they're entitled to everything.
Man, I still can't believe the Van Graffs took Pacer out.
Shame about Pacer. We all tried to tell him to kick the habit, with that condition of his. He always did his own thing, I'll give him that.
I used to guard at the gate, but there's no money in it these days. Only the big name guards get any business.
Thank god the Followers are here. I'd probably be dead now if it weren't for their doctors.
It's never dull in Freeside, is it?
Heya, what's shakin'?
Hey there.
What's going on?
Whoa, someone's just come from the Wrangler. {Emphasis on "someone's"}
Keep it down, would ya? I already got a splitting headache.
Whatever. Knock yourself out, for all I care.
You want to be getting that gun out of my face right now.
That's not funny.
Quit screwing around!
That's some egg you just laid there, pal. You mind picking it back up?
You can't just toss those around when you feel like it!
Damn, be careful with those things!
Got any more of those? I wanna blow something up too!
Personal space meaning anything to you, guy?
Personal space meaning anything to you, lady?

Going to the Wrangler tonight?
Hey man, what are you up to?

Great, another fuckin' robot.
Hey.
What's up?
Hi.
What are you looking at?
Um, er, excuse me. I'll just get out of your way.
You got something you want to say?
Yeah?
{Slightly sarcastic} May I help you?
Hey, what's up?
Hey, pal.
Hey, doll.
Look who it is. Freeside's favorite son.
Look who it is. Freeside's leading lady.
Hey, it's good to see you.
Hey there. You're the King's friend, right?
You here to start trouble?
You in the right neighborhood?
I'd keep moving, if I were you.
You know, I was just talking about trash, and here you are.
Don't think the shit you've pulled has been forgotten.
You want some of this?
If it isn't Rex! Haven't seen you in a while, boy.
Hey Rexie, who's a good dog? {The "who's a good dog?" part is said in that odd way that people reserve exclusively for pets.}
Hello, cutie.
What's a pretty girl like you doing with someone like this?
You need a boyfriend, honey?
{Wolf whistles}
You want to have some fun with a real man, baby?
Want a massage, cutie? No charge.
Buy you a drink, honey?
Hey baby. Wanna get wild tonight?
Wanna come back to my place? I've got my own mattress and everything.
What's the rush, baby? Stay awhile.
Why not try following me around for a while, darling? I'll take you someplace nice.
You're not from around here, right?
You're going the wrong way, beautiful. My place is the other way.
Hey, baby. I know a quiet place we can be alone. Or a loud place if you're one of those.
I owe you Follower people a beer for patching me up a while back.
Nothing, man.
Just hanging out. Same as usual.
I was thinking of taking a walk a little later.
I might be going scum-hunting later. You game?
Nothing. Want to head to the Wrangler later?
Yeah, sounds cool.
Nah, I'm gonna be busy.
Maybe, depends on how my girl's feeling.
Where else?
Nah, I'm gonna chill with my girl.
Can't. The King's got me busy on something.
Yeah, that's what I thought.
What the-?
You're dead!
Nobody messes with the Kings.
Not my problem.
Sucks to be you.
You've got nothing!
Take this!
This is how we do it in Freeside!
Let's kill this guy!
Let's kill this chick!
Die!
Don't mess with us!
I'll make this quick!
Let's bleed this fool!
Freeside is ours!
Hey guys, watch this!
Everyone back off!
Gotta run!
Yikes!
{death grunt}
Got me...
Damn... it...
You'll pay for that!
Bastard!
Think you can take me down too?
Catch!
Here, on me!
Fuck this!
I'm out of here!
I just remembered I gotta be somewhere else!
This is the Kings' turf. Scram!
You should head back if you know what's good for you.
Back off!
Ow!
Oof!
Ah shit!
Agh!
Damn!
What the shit?
You got a deathwish?
That's life in Freeside for you.
That had to hurt.
That hurt me just watching it.
Are you crazy?
Stealing from a King is a capital offense in Freeside.
I thought I smelled a rat.
Haaa!
Huh!
{heavy grunt}
That belongs to the Kings!
Hey, that's ours!
You gonna pay for that?
You better hope I don't find you.
Come out, if you dare.
Save us both some time and come on out.
Don't make me come looking for you.
Just stay right where you are. I'll find you.
There you are!
Guess you're not so good at hiding, huh?
I knew I'd find you!
Got you!
There's no escape now!
Guess I'm hearing things.
Probably just a rat.
Bah, it's nothing.
I got better things to do than jump at noises.
Whatever.
Where'd you go? I ain't done with you.
Don't think you can get away.
Whoa. Spooky.
Must've blinked or something.
That's right. Run!
Done and done.
Hope you enjoyed your stay in Freeside.
And... we're done here.
The Kings reign supreme.
Is that it?
{Sighs} C'mon. Less hiding, more fighting!
Come out, come out, wherever you are...
We *will* find you, you know.
You're only delaying the inevitable.
I'm starting to get bored.
What say you come out and take your asskicking like a man?
Not so sneaky, are we?
Gotcha!
There you are!
Couldn't run forever...
Nowhere to run now!
All right, I'm offically saying screw this.
Let's go home, boys.
This is dullsville. Let's bounce.
Let's go do something else.
You're not worth my time.
Someone there?
What was that?
You guys hear something?
Shhh. I hear something.
Yeah, I heard it too.
Come and get it!
Nobody messes with the Kings!
Let's get him, boys!
You're dead, punk!
And I was just getting bored!
The lady's mine, boys!
Leave some for me!
I want to get some licks in, too!
Yeah, let's show them how Kings rumble.
